purpose: Separate selection portraits and lateral combat idle sprites

specs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: separate in-engine idle sprite for a SIDE-VIEW 2D fighting game. Input image 1 is the exact official Silent Hill Downpour Brawler identity reference; input image 2 is the existing character-selection art, a color/material reference only. Produce ONE full-body BRAWLER in a genuinely lateral combat guard facing SCREEN RIGHT. Turn his entire head, ribcage, pelvis and both feet toward the opponent at the right edge: nose and open mouth in clear right profile, the visible near shoulder overlaps the far shoulder; the chest is mostly seen from the side, never square to the viewer. Camera level, orthographic side-on gameplay view, not an isometric or roster presentation angle. He braces with knees slightly bent, rightward front foot and rear foot separated horizontally on one ground baseline, both closed fists held ahead of the torso in a rough heavy brawler guard. Preserve the exact short dark hair, gaunt distressed face, paired narrow upright forehead restraint bands and jaw frame, tattooed heavy muscular torso, olive-brown loose trousers, bare feet and metal ankle restraints. Both hands are empty. Retain the supplied design and proportions, no new wounds, gore or redesigned armor. Crisp detailed realistic painted 2D sprite, neutral light, no outline glow or color fringe. Entire top of restraint, both fists, both feet and all anatomy inside the frame, generous 8% empty transparent padding. Request native 2160x3840 portrait if supported; TRUE transparent alpha background. No environment, floor plane, floor shadow, text, watermark, duplicate pose, portrait composition or opponent.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: separate SIDE-ON combat idle sprite for a 2D fighting game. Image 1 is the named official Silent Hill Downpour Stabber reference (existing Agile profile), image 2 is existing selection artwork for identity/colors only. Generate one ENTIRE exact Stabber, rotated into a right-facing SIDE PROFILE combat stance. His nose, face frame, chest, hips, knees and toes point at the enemy offscreen RIGHT, not toward the viewer. Camera is horizontal at body height, orthographic game side view, no top-down floor perspective. Preserve his angular cage around head and jaw, short brown hair, asymmetric muscular tattooed pale torso, larger weapon arm holding ONE long thin pointed metal blade, thinner empty other arm, dark olive loose trousers, ankle cuffs and bare feet. Adapt pose into a low agile idle: knees flexed, feet separated fore-and-aft horizontally on the same baseline, free fist slightly ahead, weapon hand held low beside the forward hip, complete blade sloping toward the right in readable side silhouette without touching the crop. Near and far limbs separated enough to count exactly two arms and two legs. Retain exact costume and anatomy; do not turn him into Brawler, add weaponry, wounds or splatter. Detailed realistic painted 2D game art consistent with image2, clean edges with no colored fringe. Full head restraint, full hands, weapon tip and both soles visible with at least 8% transparent padding. True alpha background, native 2160x3840 portrait requested if supported. No opponent, floor, shadow, scenery, labels, multiple views or frontal selection pose.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: standalone SIDE-VIEW fighting-game combat idle sprite. Reference1 is the exact official Silent Hill Downpour Shadow render; reference2 is our matching selection image for material/color continuity, not the desired pose. Create one full-body exact adult Shadow turned into a strict SCREEN-RIGHT side-on guard. Head and hollow mask mouth look right in clear profile; shoulders and hips are side-on, near shoulder overlaps the far one; do not show a front-facing chest or look at camera. Orthographic horizontal side-view fighting-game camera with no elevated view. Keep the short grey bob haircut, pale hollow mask face, dark sleeveless bodice with thin red straps, aged torn striped stockings, red forearms and fully covered feet. The canonical hunched torso leans slightly toward the right-side opponent; knees flexed, one foot forward and one back horizontally along the same ground baseline. Both empty claw-like hands are poised ahead at different heights, fully readable and separated, not reaching toward the viewer. Maintain exact outfit, adult body proportions and material colors, without adding injury, blood spray or accessories. Crisp highly detailed realistic painted 2D sprite, soft neutral illumination and clean alpha contours with no colored fringe. Whole hair, fingers, feet and all silhouette contained with 8% transparent safety margin; native 2160x3840 portrait requested if supported. TRUE transparent background, no painted checkerboard, no scene, floor shadow, text, watermark, enemy, alternate views, duplication or frontal character-selection composition.
